risk_if_not_implemented: Without Assessment Rigor, the organization may fail to meet statutory, regulatory or contractual obligations, or be unable to demonstrate conformity when required. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), Unreliable Assurance / Decision Information (R-GV-10), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11).

compensating_control_1.name: Penetration Testing
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct penetration testing on Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS).
compensating_control_1.justification: Penetration Testing (VPM-18) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Assessment Rigor (CPL-12) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Conformity Monitoring
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to validate that Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) conform to the organization's security, compliance and/or resilience policies, standards and other applicable requirements.
compensating_control_2.justification: Conformity Monitoring (CPL-05) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Assessment Rigor (CPL-12) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
